name: Seiren Co.,Ltd.
summary: Seiren Co.,Ltd. manufactures and markets textile products, industrial machines, and electronic parts in Japan and internationally. The company operates through five segments: Vehicle Upholstery Materials, High Fashion Materials, Electronics Materials, Environmental & Life Materials, and Medical Materials. The Vehicle Materials segment offers interior materials for automobiles, railway cars, etc., as well as seat materials, air bags, and decorative parts. The High Fashion Materials segment engages in textile processing, and various clothing products.
